study: long-only weekly cross-sectional momentum over a point-in-time top-30 Binance USDT universe (delisted pairs included), seven pre-registered candidates judged by the bar, against a turnover- and exposure-matched random-selection null; combined with the incumbent Revolut X row trend-4h
bar: a candidate passes when its out-of-sample return is positive on BOTH windows A and B, AND its worst window of A–D is above the 95th percentile (s[floor(0.95·n)], n = 1000) of its matched null's worst window. §4.15's 35 % drawdown limit is reported beside it.

definitions.rebalance: weekly: decide on Sunday's close (UTC), fill at Monday's open; each run also forms on its first day
definitions.selection: best in-sample return / max(0.05, drawdown); first in grid order on a tie

spreads.rule: half the median full spread per side; unmeasured pairs the widest measured median

excluded.why: stablecoin / pegged: USD stablecoin (USDP's old ticker)
stablecoin / pegged: USD stablecoin (TerraUSD, the pair traded 2021-12-24 → 2022-05-13)

simulatorChecks.detail: slots equal true over 54 rebalances; kept more 0, kept fewer 2

candidates.filter: all 36 points (k, L, abs, regime) chosen in sample

fourCoinControl.rule: descriptive, never a candidate: top 2 of BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP USDT by 28-day return, each held only above its 100-day mean, weekly, this engine and costs

chance.method: for each candidate, the share of its 1,000 matched-null draws that pass the same bar (A > 0, B > 0, worst window above the candidate's own null p95); summed over candidates; P(≥ observed) is the exact Poisson-binomial tail over those shares

combination.rule: $50 in the xsmom book and $50 in the incumbent (primary evaluation), each compounding in its own account, summed; on the xsmom window calendar
